work.author: GREGORIUS PP. XVI.
work.description: Indult XV grants rochet and violet mozzetta to the canons of Sgurgola; LF2980 → LF2992 across provenance LF2983–2986 and page number LF2989; complete 24 March 1835 closing LF3031–3034. Refined body and full surrounding frame read literally. Issuer evidence is GREGORIUS PP. XVI. at LF2943–2943; the source closing at LF3031–3034 reads: Datum Romae apud s. Petrum sub annulo piscatoris die vigesima quarta martii millesimo octingentesimo trigesimo quinto, pontificatus Nostri anno quinto. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
